title: Latching relay logic
goal: A reader must be able to follow the start-stop seal-in path and see the same relay switch a load and indicator.

rubric.must: Separate STOP NC and START NO pushbuttons are visible.
A relay coil labelled K1 LATCH COIL is visible.
A normally open contact labelled K1 NO SEAL-IN is visibly parallel with the start path.
A K1 changeover contact visibly switches the load branch.
A 24 VDC load lamp and green LATCHED pilot light are visible.
The 24 VDC supply is clearly labelled.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Three-wire control: the break contact in series, the make contact in parallel with the start button as the seal-in, and the changeover contact switching the load and its indicator. The unused break side is tied to the common, which the source asks for and which is harmless.
